title: Radiotherapy for Malignant Astrocytomas in the Elderly
brief_summary: A randomized trial comparing radiotherapy with supportive care in patients aged 70 years or older with newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed anaplastic astrocytoma or glioblastoma, and a Karnofsky performance status \> 70.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Glioblastoma and anaplastic astrocytoma, supratentorial, histologically confirmed
* Brain CT scan or MRI within 28 days before surgery
* Age: 70 years or older
* Karnofsky performance status, 70 or more.
* Life expectancy over 12 weeks
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Brain radiotherapy
* Chemotherapy
* Severe systemic disease
